This refers to the note for public & Stakeholder consultation dated 15.04 . 2024 placed in public domain on the above cited subject. 2 . In this regard, this department received requests from concerned Stakeholder seeking text of the proposed provisions which are highlighted in para no . 5 of the above mentioned note dated 15.04.2024. 3. Therefore , for better understanding for the general public and concerned stakeholder of the provisions which are proposed to be amendment/ inserted and to achieve the objective of Public & Stakeholder Consultations in more true & letter spirit. The detailed comparative Statement of the relevant existing provisions of the Explosives Act, 1884 and the proposed provisions in the draft Explosive Bill, 2024 are annexed herewith for ready reference. 4. This note shall be treated as in addition to the note dated 15.04.2024. Further, time for seeking comments/ suggestions from the General public, Industry associations and other persons and entities concerned has also been extended till 25.05.2024. 5. This issues with the approval of the competent authority. (2) Notwithstanding anything contained in an y other law for the time being in force , no court shall take cognizance of an offence under the repealed Act after the expiry of a period of three years from the date of the commencement of this Act .
